title: ChatGPT Pro 20X Renewal Monthly | Official Card [Active Accounts Only]
subtitle: For active Pro 20X accounts renewing via card (Philippines region preferred). Expired accounts or iOS/Google Play subscriptions cannot use this channel.
warnings: 【Must be unexpired】: If your PRO 20X has expired and reverted to free, this channel cannot be used.
【Active accounts only】: If your PRO 20X is still active, you can renew via this channel.
【Channel requirements】: Previous payment must be card top-up (Philippines region preferred; US/JP contact support to confirm).
【Incompatible channels】: Subscriptions created via iOS (App Store) or Google Play cannot be renewed through this channel.

detail.title: ChatGPT Pro 20X Renewal Monthly | Official Card [Active Accounts Only]
detail.subtitle: Official card renewal channel. Requires previous subscription to be card top-up (PH region preferred). Only active, unexpired Pro 20X accounts are supported.

sections.title: Eligibility (Read Before Ordering)
items: ❌ Condition 1 (Expired): If your PRO 20X has already expired and reverted to free, it CANNOT be renewed via this channel (please purchase a 2300 RMB ready account instead).
✔️ Condition 2 (Active & Unexpired): If your PRO 20X is still within its active validity period, you can renew through this channel.

sections.title: Channel & Account Requirements
items: Previous payment must be card top-up (Philippines region preferred; US/JP accounts supported upon confirmation).
Subscriptions created via iOS (App Store) or Google Play cannot use this renewal channel.
Processed manually by customer support within 10–30 minutes.
